### FINDING 1 — fs-every-aleph-is-regular — Fact L2 widens the cited definition and omits the clause used by the refutation
LOCATION: Facts & Assumptions [L2], line 58; Refutation step 2.1, line 72
QUOTE: "[L2] A cardinal $\kappa$ is regular when $\operatorname{cf}(\kappa) = \kappa$ ([[def-cofinality]], [[def-cardinal]])."
DEFECT: The cited definition restricts regular and singular to infinite cardinals, but L2 drops that domain restriction. It also omits the definition of singular even though step 2.1 cites L2 to conclude that the witness is singular.
EVIDENCE: The cited target states: "**Regular and singular.** An **infinite cardinal** $\kappa$ ([[def-cardinal]], [[def-aleph-and-beth-hierarchies]]) is

- **regular** when $\operatorname{cf}(\kappa) = \kappa$;
- **singular** when $\operatorname{cf}(\kappa) \ne \kappa$."
SEVERITY: fatal
MINIMAL REPAIR: "[L2] An infinite cardinal $\kappa$ is regular when $\operatorname{cf}(\kappa) = \kappa$ and singular when $\operatorname{cf}(\kappa) \ne \kappa$ ([[def-cofinality]], [[def-cardinal]])."
